_about: English language pack for GDL (Ghost Description Language)
_note: This file provides English translations for all human-readable text in GDL schema and knowledge files. Keys mirror the original Japanese structure.

_levels._description: GDL detail level definitions. Determines which level each item belongs to.

Lv1.purpose: Can reproduce speech patterns, tone, and basic preferences

Lv2.purpose: Can predict judgment/reasoning patterns and value-based behavior
Lv2.focus: How — Thinking & acting (thought processes & decision criteria)

Lv3.purpose: Can achieve deep personality reproduction including life context, contradictions, and inner conflicts
Lv3.focus: Why — Root causes (deep psychology, formative history & internal contradictions)

_confidence._description: Confidence annotations for GDL fields. Applied when GDL is generated through indirect methods (text analysis, behavioral observation, third-party information, etc.) rather than direct self-reporting.
_confidence.when_used: Not required when generation_method is 'input_form' or 'interview' (direct responses). Required when using indirect methods like 'text_analysis' or 'observation'.

high.meaning: Explicit statement or very strong evidence exists

medium.meaning: Reasonable inference from multiple indirect pieces of evidence
medium.ai_instruction: Generally reflect this, but flexibly adjust if contradictory information exists

low.ai_instruction: Treat as reference only; ignore if contradictory information exists

user_confirmed.meaning: Value confirmed or corrected by the person themselves
user_confirmed.ai_instruction: Trust at least as much as 'high'

user_provided.meaning: Information directly provided by the person
user_provided.ai_instruction: Treat as the most reliable value

field_format.without_confidence: Store value directly (when the person answered directly)

_meta._description: Field definitions for the meta section. Stores management information for GDL data.

subject_id.description: Unique identifier for the subject person

detail_level.description: Detail level to use. Numeric 1-3 or 'adaptive' (adaptively output based on inferable range)

generation_method.description: GDL generation method. _confidence annotation is recommended for indirect methods

source_type.description: Type of analysis source (for indirect generation only)

source_summary.description: Summary of analysis target (for indirect generation only)

target_person.description: Name of target person (for multi-speaker only)

speakers_detected.description: List of detected speakers (for multi-speaker only)

_preamble._description: Specification for the AI interpretation guide included at the beginning of GDL output. Self-describing information for AI reading GDL JSON as a system prompt to correctly interpret the data. Must not be omitted.

what.example: GDL (Ghost Description Language) — Structured data describing a person's individuality.

purpose.description: Expected behavior from AI reading GDL
purpose.example: Understand this person's individuality and reproduce responses, judgments, and expressions that reflect who they are.

scale_convention.example: Numeric fields use a 5-point scale (1=strongly disagree, 5=strongly agree). Each item includes a label describing its meaning.

array_convention.example: Array fields are ordered by importance (first item = most important/most applicable).

rank_convention.example: Rank arrays represent the person's chosen priority order (first = most important).

usage.example: Designed to be included in system prompts or context windows.

confidence_convention.description: Interpretation rules for confidence annotations. Included when generated through indirect methods (text_analysis, etc.). Compliant with the _confidence specification.
confidence_convention.when_included: When generation_method is an indirect method

section_descriptions._description: Attach a _description key to each section explaining its purpose. Required for AI to understand the meaning of each section.

values.identity: Basic identification (name, gender, occupation, life stage, etc.)
values.background: History & experience (education, career, life turning points)
values.personality: Personality & behavioral tendencies (emotional patterns, decision-making style, particular preferences)

_labels._description: Label-to-English translation map for all GDL fields. Data keys are clean English keys; this map provides human-readable labels.

identity.description: Basic identification (name, gender, occupation, life stage, etc.)
identity.extraction_tips: From self-introductions, profile sections, signatures, and title descriptions. Look for 'I am...' sentence patterns.

identity_narrative.label: Personal narrative (where from and where to)

mortality_awareness_impact.label: Impact of death awareness on identity

identity_symbols.label: Objects, places, or words that symbolize oneself

appearance.extraction_tips: Almost impossible to infer from text. Only when self-descriptions or photo references exist.

workwear_vs_casualwear.label: Gap between work and casual wear

background.description: History & experience (education, career, life turning points)
background.extraction_tips: From career introductions, past experience references, temporal expressions like 'years ago' or 'after going through...'.

parallel_lives.label: Another life (if different choices were made)

health_philosophy.label: Health view (relationship between body and mind)

philosophy.extraction_tips: Most richly extractable from text analysis. Focus on assertions, opinions, quotes, 'should' / 'I believe' expressions, and objects of approval/disapproval.

sensory_memories.label: Sensory memories (memories triggered by smell, sound, taste)

expression.extraction_tips: The text itself is direct evidence of expression. Analyze writing style, metaphor usage, logical structure, humor type, and sentence-ending characteristics.

counterargument_handling.label: How one handles being challenged
candidates: Puts on hold to think later

topic_transition_style.label: How topics are changed
candidates: Leaves it to the other person

relationships.extraction_tips: From how others are referenced, 'we' vs. 'I' usage, interest in social topics, and mentions of family/friends.

cross_generational_interaction.label: Intergenerational interaction style
candidates: Easy to talk with older people
Easy to talk with younger people

episodes.extraction_tips: The text itself becomes the source of episodes. Record as source information rather than analysis results.

personality_assessments.extraction_tips: Only when the person explicitly states assessment results. Never infer MBTI or similar from text (as it would be inaccurate).
